name: Let's Eat Dinner Together
description: As more and more people are getting used to eating dinner alone, Kang Ho-dong and Lee Kyung-kyu visit ordinary Korean families at dinner time and share their lives as they eat dinner together.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Lee Kyung-kyu and Kang Ho-dong visit Mangwon-dong in an attempt to find a household to eat dinner with before 8pm
